answer: Before an agent may book freight, the FMCSA registration check binds one MC docket number to one legal entity, one surety bond on file and one designated agent, so a second brokerage trading under that docket is refused at the load board. A duplicated docket trips an authority revocation, a claim against the BMC-84 bond and a civil penalty. Registration runs 300, the bond 75000 and the filing 150, so N fakes cost N x 75450 plus N filed tariffs, and each still needs a real carrier to haul. A jade container on the jetty and a sparrow in the warehouse rafter change nothing in that registry.
